summary: Fix floating-point to uint128 word ordering
explanation: All six failures are in Uint128.ConversionTests and share one cause: MakeUint128 takes (high, low), but MakeUint128FromFloat reverses those arguments. At line 280, from_precise_double differs from from_precise_ints; at line 287, converting from_approx_double back to double yields about 1.84e19 instead of approx_double at about 3.40e38. At lines 293–294, round_to_five and round_to_nine convert to values shifted into the high word instead of 5 and 9. At lines 300 and 306, converting highest_precision_in_long_double and its masked value back from long double likewise places low-word bits in the high word. Pass the computed high word first and low word second for values at least 2^64, and put smaller values in the low word with a zero high word. The existing truncation and range checks remain intact.
